name: Lone Star Structures
description: Independent dealer of engineered steel building kits and wood portable buildings — garages, workshops, barns, barndominiums and commercial clear spans.
dealerNotice: Lone Star Structures is an independent authorized dealer. Every building we sell is manufactured by one of our production partners and ships direct from the plant nearest the jobsite. Steel kits ship nationwide and are erected on site; wood portable buildings arrive finished within our regional delivery area.
